name: Media Downloader
shortDescription: Download video or extract audio with yt-dlp inside BTT Launcher.
description: A native BetterTouchTool Launcher plugin with video and audio presets, metadata and thumbnail previews, progress reporting, playlists, multi-item queues, text search, Spotify track resolution, browser cookies, destination selection, dependency checks, updates, and logs.
author: loaykhalifa
requirements: Apple Command Line Tools if BetterTouchTool requests them for Swift compilation
permissions: Runs yt-dlp to fetch metadata, thumbnails, estimates, and media
Uses ffmpeg and ffprobe through yt-dlp for merging, conversion, and extraction
Runs Homebrew update, install, and upgrade commands only when Update Tools is selected
Reads the clipboard when the plugin surface opens and when Paste is selected
Downloads remote thumbnail images for preview
Contacts Spotify's oEmbed endpoint when resolving an individual Spotify track
Can read selected browser cookies through yt-dlp
Writes downloads to the selected folder, defaulting to ~/Downloads/BTT Media Downloads
Writes the latest troubleshooting output to ~/Library/Logs/BTTMediaDownloader.log
Runs a shell command to terminate the active process tree when Cancel is selected
installation: Install yt-dlp and ffmpeg with Apple Silicon Homebrew.
Restart BetterTouchTool or wait for its Swift plugin watcher to reload the file.
Open BTT Launcher, search for Media Downloader, and open the result.
limitations: This release uses Apple Silicon Homebrew paths under /opt/homebrew.
Spotify support is limited to individual track links resolved to a YouTube search.
Supported sites and formats depend on yt-dlp.
